newsitem.title: UK: MEPC takes 73.2 mln stg charge for 1997.
newsitem.headline: MEPC takes 73.2 mln stg charge for 1997.

text.p: British real estate group MEPC Plc said on Monday it planned to cancel some interest rate swap agreements to cut its future sterling financing costs.

The company said the move would cut its overall effective interest cost by around 1.5 percent and would raise pre-tax profit before exceptional items by nine million stg in the second half of this year.

However, the company said it would incur a pre-tax exceptional charge of 73.2 million stg against its 1997 earnings because of the cancellations, cutting earnings per share by 11.7p. The net reduction for the year will be 10.2p because of lower financing costs, MEPC said.
